description:
Get ChEMBL target classification for a target.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_class — one record = one ChEMBL target class of one gene at one level.
Key: id, targetClass[].id, targetClass[].level.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: one row = one item (one ChEMBL target class of one gene at one level); `_vbt.total` counts items.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. ChEMBL target classes integrated by OT 25.09; a gene with no class was not classified.

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
